claims.claim: The v1.2 request and plan records are closed, bounded, and locally resolvable.
claims.passCondition: Both schemas parse, every local reference resolves, every object node is closed, and the module contract grants no permissions or writes.
claims.counterevidence: Unknown fields, unresolved references, permission, write, provider, or lifecycle authority.

claims.claim: Identical normalized inputs produce byte-identical application plans.
claims.passCondition: Repeated focused executions have identical canonical JSON, digest, byte measurement, ordering, and lineage.
claims.counterevidence: Locale, input ordering, clock, workspace, or host state changes output.
claims.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: strict deterministic rebuild from the installed catalog

claims.claim: Only selected recipes visible as eligible in exact installed discovery evidence can enter a plan.
claims.passCondition: Forged, stale, held, undiscovered, re-digested, ambiguous, or mode-expanded records fail closed.
claims.counterevidence: A self-consistent replacement pack or held result reaches an application record.
claims.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: v1.0 and v1.1 installed-byte rebuild verifiers

claims.claim: The plan binds the exact blueprint, evidence, action, resource, lifecycle, and re-consent scope without claiming authenticated human consent.
claims.passCondition: Consent drift fails closed and every valid plan remains AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED with authority NONE.
claims.primarySurface: grounded-consent deterministic evaluation plus adversarial focused selftest
claims.counterevidence: Expanded permission, network, lifecycle, resources, stale time, or changed bytes still produce a valid plan.

claims.claim: Recipe source is neither emitted, copied, applied, nor executed by the planner.
claims.passCondition: Only REFERENCE_ONLY selection is accepted; plan records contain metadata and snippet references but no snippet field or generated code.
claims.counterevidence: Snippet text, provider output, executable bundle, or direct-reuse authorization appears in a valid plan.

claims.claim: No candidate runtime or visual surface is produced by v1.2.
claims.passCondition: Plan truth and contract both keep candidate null, implementation NOT_STARTED, tests NOT_RUN, and browser testing N/A.
claims.counterevidence: A candidate file, sandbox action, UI claim, or execution receipt is emitted.
